Husband murdered by wife and lover in South Delhi

Police in South Delhi arrested a woman and her lover for the murder of her husband. The couple allegedly drugged the victim, electrocuted his private parts, and then staged the scene to appear as a robbery. The motive is believed to be infidelity and financial gain, with the couple planning to live together. Weapons and blood-stained clothes were recovered. The incident occurred in Sangam Vihar.
